triples.quote: At her death almost exactly the same thing happened to the two little boys as to their elder brother, Mitya. They were completely forgotten and abandoned by their father.

triples.subject: Grigory
triples.quote: He championed her cause, abusing Fyodor Pavlovitch in a manner little befitting a servant, and on one occasion broke up the revels and drove all the disorderly women out of the house.

triples.subject: Yefim Petrovitch Polenov
triples.quote: He became especially fond of the younger, Alexey, who lived for a long while as one of his family.

triples.subject: Yefim Petrovitch Polenov
triples.quote: And to Yefim Petrovitch, a man of a generosity and humanity rarely to be met with, the young people were more indebted for their education and bringing up than to any one.

triples.subject: Grigory
triples.quote: They were looked after by the same Grigory and lived in his cottage, where they were found by the tyrannical old lady who had brought up their mother.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: Learning the author’s name, they were interested in his being a native of the town and the son of “that Fyodor Pavlovitch.”

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: though he was always afraid that his sons Ivan and Alexey would also come to ask him for it.

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: It was only later that we learned that Ivan had come partly at the request of, and in the interests of, his elder brother, Dmitri

triples.subject: Alexey
triples.quote: The younger brother, Alexey, had been a year already among us, having been the first of the three to arrive.

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: his elder brother Dmitri, who was in open quarrel with his father and even planning to bring an action against him.

triples.subject: Pyotr Alexandrovitch Miüsov
triples.quote: Pyotr Alexandrovitch Miüsov, of whom we have spoken already, the cousin of Fyodor Pavlovitch’s first wife, happened to be in the neighborhood again on a visit to his estate.

triples.subject: Pyotr Alexandrovitch Miüsov
triples.quote: He had come from Paris, which was his permanent home.

triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: And here the young man was staying in the house of such a father, had been living with him for two months, and they were on the best possible terms.

triples.subject: Alexey
triples.quote: Yes, he had been for the last year in our monastery, and seemed willing to be cloistered there for the rest of his life.
